leadText:
The Mothers for Pokémon, abbreviated as M.F.P., (Japanese: ポケモン大好きママさん Pokémon Daisuki Mama-san, P.M.D.M.) are recurring characters who appeared in A Fan with a Plan and Cruisin' for a Losin. They are a group of wives and mothers who love and Pokémon Contests. There are six known members, and they are based in Rubello Town in the Hoenn region. Savannah appears to be their leader, as the other members claim that she is their "pride and joy" because she won a Ribbon before.

They seem to be obsessed with famous people, such as Drew and Norman. They claim to have pictures of Drew from every Pokémon Contest he has entered. They also have other Drew- and Norman-related merchandise.
 
While Savannah was getting ready for the R1 Rubello Contest, the other M.F.P. members were out doing her shopping and other chores. During the event, they were shown to be cheering for Savannah, Drew, and .
